title: Cloudy With a Chance of Incineration: Predicting Weather on Distant Worlds - Nautilus
gist: A study in Astronomy & Astrophysics details a new method for decoding the light flickers of exoplanets and other distant objects to infer both weather conditions and their drivers. Atmospheric readings matter because they reveal how distant worlds formed, what they are made of and how likely they are to host life.
